name: Tempered Iron
description: A solid, reliable metal. Provides standard physical enhancement.

name: Stately Mithril
description: Extremely lightweight and responsive metal that sharpens easily.

name: Brittle Obsidian
description: A dark, glassy volcanic block. High critical rate, but unstable damage.

name: Primal Dragon Scale
description: A glowing red scale containing ancient raw force.

name: Withered Fey Bone
description: Eerie material humming with vitality absorption.

name: Ancient Fishing Pole
description: A finely sanded pine-wood rod bound with nylon fiber thread. Allows angling next to quiet lakes, ponds, and riverbanks.

name: Glimmering River Fish (Raw)
description: Freshly caught uncooked fish. Yields some standard nutrition, but is highly delectable if grilled.

name: Campfire Grilled Fish
description: Cooked over hot natural burning wood embers. Restores high quantities of raw Health (+45 HP) and magical Focus (+30 MP).

name: Prime Wild Meat (Raw)
description: Rich, high-quality game meat harvested from overworld wildlife. High nutritional value, best cooked at a cozy campfire.

name: Prime Flame-Grilled Steak
description: Roasted to medium-rare over crackling campfire logs. Restores massive Health (+60 HP) and boosts magical Focus (+15 MP).

name: Thick Wildlife Hide
description: A dense leather hide. Highly sought after by leatherworkers and blacksmiths for reinforcing armor plates.

name: Tension Lockpick
description: A thin, tempered steel wire lockpick. Essential for cracking secure dungeon chests and outlaw camp caches without alerting guards.

name: Grim Skeleton Key
description: A rare single-use skull-headed key forged from dark iron and soul essence. Instantly opens any locked chest.

name: Faction Watchtower Key
description: A heavy brass key bearing the insignia of the watchtower garrison commander. Opens the Faction Tribute Chest.

name: Oakhaven Timber
description: Sturdy harvested forest pine or birch timber. Extremely valuable in the desert, rare in the tundra, and abundant in the forest.

name: Aromatic Pine Log
description: Dense, aromatic softwood. Excellent for alchemical cooking and hot burning campfires.

name: Pale Birch Log
description: Lightweight, clean-burning pale timber. Highly sought after for precise crafting.

name: Raw Copper Ore
description: Unrefined orange copper ore mined from overworld veins. Great for basic alchemical alloying.

name: Raw Iron Ore
description: Dense, heavy mineral ore mined from rich iron veins. Smelted to create steel or tempered alloys.
